newsitem.title: UK: Ldn freight - Panamaxes set a scorching pace again.
newsitem.headline: Ldn freight - Panamaxes set a scorching pace again.

text.p: Panamaxes continue to set a scorching pace in the London dry cargo freight market.

Timecharter business from US Gulf to the Far East dominated by grain and Australian coal round voyages to Japan, S Korea and China have been the most influential trades in propelling the market upwards. Charterers have resorted in many cases to 3-5 or 4-6 months period business in order to obtain some relief from the steeply rising trip rate, and such fixtures have become a strong feature of the current market.

The US Gulf is proving to be a very difficult area for charterers with November Panamax stems and brokers noted a further increase today in Japanese chartering enquiry in the Far East. The BFI shot up 35 points to 1393. Caper business was reported to be steadier although some brokers have little faith in the latest improvement extending beyond the end of the year. Handy-size rates have remained generally depressed with somearginal gains seen for modern types in the East.

GRAIN Tigris 122,647 dwt was understood to have failed with IrisL delivery Continent for a trip via E Canada to Iran at $10,000 daily. No other Caper involvement in the grain trades was reported today but demand for Panamaxes continued to be very strong. Katrina were said to be struggling to cover US Gulf/Taiwan for Nov 20/30, having bid and failed with Oceanic Explorer 68,849 dwt delivery US Gulf at $13,850 daily plus $380,000 bonus, among others. Wada al Arish 70,087 dwt, which had also been bid by Katrina, was fixed by unnamed charterers delivery prompt East Med for the same trip at $13,500 daily. Andre and Dreyfus were both said to be working Panamax tonnage from E Coast S America to China but further information was lacking.
Continental were active booking tonnage for short periods, for instance 1976-built Stef 60,214 dwt delivery prompt S Korea for 3-5 months at $8,500 daily.

Evlimeni 64,794 dwt was rumoured fixed to Shadab for NoPac/Bin Qasim grain and these charterers have at least one more similar stem to cover. Glencore were understood to have booked tonnage for 20/25,000 meals Plate/China at about $35.00.

New orders included Cargill with 30/60,000 49' US Gulf/Continent for Nov 25/dec 5 (ideas $12.75 basis Panamax), ADM 20,000 hss US Gulf/Vera Cruz for Nov 9/14, and Glencore 20,000/5 oats Victori W C Mexico for Nov 15/20.

Hoegh are believed to have fixed Merchant Prestige 161,000 dwt on subjects delivery China end Dec for 2 years at $15,300 daily with an option of a 3rd year at $20,000 daily. Iolcos Spirit 93,000 dwt was rumoured fixed to Navios delivery prompt Gibraltar for 2-4 or 3-5 months. KWK Legacy 168,000 dwt was fixed for unknown business from Rotterdam mid-Nov.

Reported Panamax short period fixtures included the newbuilding Oinoussian Lion 71,200 dwt delivery Japan Nov 23 for 2 Pacific rounds to Japanese charterers at $11,000/11,500 daily, Silver Star 69,000 dwt for 3-5 months at $11,000/11,500 daily and Sea Diamond 69,000 dwt for 4-6 months at $11,400/11,500 daily, both delivery mid-Nov Japan to Halla, and Waimea 61,751 dwt delivery prompt Med to Interbulk for about 4-6 months at about $8,750 daily.

Trip rates featured the relet Captain George l 64,000 dwt delivery China for an Australian round at between $11,000 and 11,500 daily, Luigi Dmato 71,000 dwt delivery Taiwan prompt trip via Indonesia to Japan at $11,750 daily, and Lia 69,447 dwt on subjects to Samsun delivery Muscat Nov 20/25 trip via S Africa to the Continent at $6,500 daily. For the most modern panamaxes rates are approaching $15,000 daily for Continent-Med/Far East and $13,000 daily for delivery Far East for NoPac or Australian rounds.

Rates have remained broadly unchanged in the Atlantic. Bunga Melor Tiga 42,000 dwt was booked by Pan Ocean Livery Continent prompt trip Far East at $11,350 daily. M and R are said to have fixed Ulcas 42,000 dwt for short period from S Africa, possibly at a little over $8,000 daily plus about $100,000 bonus, redelivery Far East. Trident Mariner 29,000 dwt open prompt E C India has been fixed on private terms, and Olympic Miracle 29,000 dwt has been taken by Pan Ocean delivery NoPac mid-nov trip Far East at a firmer $7,000 daily plus $130,000 bonus. This compares well with BHP's recent fixture of a similar vessel delivery Whyalla trip Far East at about $6,750 daily plus $65,000 bonus.
